query: I just ran swamp update. Is the swamp skill still current, and what do I run if it is not?
expected_behavior: runs scripts/check_install.py from the skill directory, or names it as the check, before answering
distinguishes the CLI reference stamp from the installed skill's identity (this repository's copy versus the upstream bundled skill)
names scripts/render_cli_reference.py for a stale reference and scripts/sync_upstream.py --diff before scripts/check_install.py --install for a replaced skill
does not hand-edit the installed skill directory
